ei.title: 주장 추론 — 팬의 권리는 선수에 대한 의무를 동반해야 한다
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고2

fullPassage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.

questions.passage: Fans who are ①<u>inclined</u> to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the ②<u>corresponded</u> obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are ③<u>entitled</u> to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are ④<u>limited</u> by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 많은 시간을 들여 선수들이 팬에게 빚진 것에 대해 생각하는 경향이 있는 팬들은 팬으로서 가질 수 있는 상응하는 의무에 대해서도 생각해야 한다. 친구에게 빚진 것에 대해 한순간도 생각하지 않으면서 친구에게 받을 자격만 생각하는 사람은 좋은 친구가 아니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① inclined: be inclined to — 형용사 보어, 적절
❌ ② corresponded: the corresponding obligations — 현재분사 형용사 수식, corresponded(과거분사)는 부적절 ←정답
✅ ③ entitled: be entitled to — 형용사 보어, 적절
✅ ④ limited: are limited by — 수동태, 적절
det.tip: corresponding(상응하는) = 현재분사 형용사. corresponded는 과거분사로 의미 불일치

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time ①<u>thinking</u> about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever ②<u>giving</u> a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that ③<u>seriously</u>. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly ④<u>fulfilled</u> their end of the bargain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 선수들이 팬에게 빚진 것에 대해 생각하느라 시간을 보내는 팬들, 한순간도 생각을 주지 않는 사람, 팬/선수 관계를 진지하게 받아들이지 못한 팬들, 그리고 거래의 자기 몫을 이행하지 못하는 팬들.
det.analysis:
✅ ① thinking: spend time thinking — 동명사 적절
✅ ② giving: without ever giving — 전치사 + 동명사 적절
✅ ③ seriously: take ~ seriously — 부사 적절
❌ ④ fulfilled: are hardly fulfilling — 진행형(현재분사) 자리에 과거분사 부적절 ←정답
det.tip: are hardly fulfilling — 진행형 be + V-ing 구문

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about ①<u>what</u> athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes ②<u>have failed</u> to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, ③<u>however</u> special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about ④<u>how</u> they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: 선수들이 팬에게 빚진 것에 대해서만 생각하는 팬들은 팬/선수 관계를 진지하게 받아들이지 못했다. 팬들이 가진 특별한 권리가 무엇이든 상응하는 의무에 의해 제한된다. 더 나은 팬이 될 수 있는 방법에 대해 생각하지 않는 팬들.
det.analysis:
✅ ① what: what athletes owe them — 관계대명사, 적절
✅ ② have failed: fans who only think ~ have failed — 현재완료, 주어 fans(복수) 적절
❌ ③ however: 원문 whatever — whatever special rights fans may possess(양보의 복합관계대명사). however는 부사절 접속사로 문장 구조 불일치 ←정답
✅ ④ how: think about how they can — 간접의문문, 적절
det.tip: whatever + 명사 = 양보 복합관계형용사. however + 형/부 = 부사절

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the ①<u>contradicting</u> obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are ②<u>entitled</u> to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that ③<u>seriously</u>. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may ④<u>possess</u> are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.

det.korean: 팬으로서의 상응하는 의무에 대해서도 생각해야 한다. 친구에게 받을 자격이 있는 것만 생각하는 사람은 좋은 친구가 아니다. 팬/선수 관계를 진지하게 받아들이지 못한 것이다. 팬이 가진 특별한 권리는 제한된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① contradicting: 원문은 corresponding(상응하는) — 권리에 '상응하는' 의무라는 맥락. contradicting(모순되는)은 반대 의미 ←정답
✅ ② entitled: '자격이 있는', 원문 일치
✅ ③ seriously: '진지하게', 원문 일치
✅ ④ possess: '소유하다', 원문 일치
det.tip: corresponding ↔ contradicting

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to ①<u>spend</u> a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding ②<u>obligations</u> that fans might have as fans. det.korean: 선수들이 빚진 것에 대해 생각하느라 많은 시간을 쓰는 팬들은 의무에 대해서도 생각해야 한다. 권리는 의무에 의해 제한된다. 거래의 자기 몫을 이행하지 못하고 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① spend: '쓰다, 보내다', 원문 일치
✅ ② obligations: '의무', 원문 일치
❌ ③ expanded: 원문은 limited(제한되는) — 권리가 의무에 의해 '제한된다'는 맥락. expanded(확장되는)는 반대 의미 ←정답
✅ ④ bargain: '거래, 합의', 원문 일치

questions.passage: Fans who are inclined to spend a lot of time thinking about what athletes owe them as fans should also think about the corresponding obligations that fans might have as fans. One who thinks only about what they are entitled to receive from their friends without ever giving a moment's thought to what they owe their friends is, to put it mildly, not a very good friend. Similarly, fans who only think about what athletes owe them without ever thinking about what they owe to athletes have failed to take the fan/athlete relationship all that seriously. As in nearly every other area of human life, whatever special rights fans may possess are limited by a corresponding set of obligations, and fans who never think about how they can be better fans even as they confidently opine about what athletes owe them are hardly fulfilling their end of the bargain.
